name: Метки карт: рамка опасности врага по рангу (ADR-0010), стихия — медальон, класс — оружие или предмет, редкость героя — кристалл карста. Стиль — по промту автора 27.09.2026: тёмное фэнтези, цифровая живопись с мягкими переходами, проработанными тенями и акцентом на деталях, магический свет, сплошной чёрный фон. Первая проба в простом стиле автором отклонена: «слишком просто»

Рамки рангов (ADR-0010).босс биома: тяжёлое золото, рога и шипы по углам
Рамки рангов (ADR-0010).рунный босс: камень с рунами, светятся бирюзой духа

style: Dark fantasy game art with a menacing, gloomy, mystical atmosphere. Digital painting with soft transitions, elaborate shadows and an artistic emphasis on details. Lighting effects bring it to life: magical glow, aura and embers, light that comes from inside the subject and from below. Rich worn materials: dark forged iron, old gold, weathered stone, carst crystals glowing from within. Precious, dramatic, high contrast.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements.
cutout_rule: The background is solid pure black ({hex}), flat, edge to edge: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no vignette, no checkerboard. Glow, aura and magical light around the subject are welcome and fade into the black. Leave a clear margin of black around the subject on all sides.

frames.frame: Format: an ornate frame for an enemy card in a dark fantasy card battler, landscape 5:4, seen straight on, symmetric. The frame is a border only. The whole canvas is solid pure black — outside the frame and inside its window alike; only the frame itself is painted, nothing inside the window. The border is about 9% of the frame width thick and richly detailed; ornaments rise above the top edge and stand out at the corners. The rank must read instantly even on a small card: the more dangerous the rank, the richer the material, the heavier the ornament and the stronger the magical light.

elements.frame: Format: game icon of an element, square, no border around the picture. A round medallion about 70% of the canvas, centered: an ornate rim of dark forged iron and old gold; inside it the element itself is alive — its sign and its energy swirl and glow in the element's own color, and a soft magical aura spills beyond the rim into the black. All seven element medallions share the same rim, so they read as one set; the living element inside makes each one unique.

classes.frame: Format: game icon of a hero class, square, no border around the picture. One weapon or item that stands for the class, centered, about 75% of the canvas, shown whole at a slight dynamic angle. Richly detailed worn materials — dark forged iron, old wood, leather, old gold — with a magical accent: glowing runes, embers or an aura in cold turquoise or warm gold. A strong silhouette that still reads when the icon is small.

rarity.frame: Format: game icon of a rarity, square, no border around the picture. One carst crystal — the magic crystal of this world — upright, centered, about 70% of the canvas, floating in the dark. The seven rarities form a ladder from a dull cracked stone to a flawless crystal blazing with inner light: the higher the rarity, the cleaner the facets, the brighter the light inside and the stronger the aura and the floating shards around it.

jobs.title: Рамка ранга: элита
jobs.source: ADR-0010 — ранги врагов; схема автора 27.09.2026: опасность врага показывает рамка
jobs.subject: Rank: Elite — the second of seven ranks, clearly above a plain rank-and-file enemy but far below a boss. Old bronze with a dark patina, heavy rivets and engraved bands along the border; at the top center a cut amber gem held in a bronze claw, a warm ember light pulsing inside the gem, faint amber embers drifting around the claw.

jobs.title: Стихия: Время
jobs.source: GDD §3.1 — семь стихий; цвет карста Энериум из art/style/style.md
jobs.subject: The element of Time: an hourglass of old gold and glass in the center of the medallion; green Energium light (#4FDC8B) swirls around it, grains of sand hang frozen in the air mid-fall, a faint green aura spills beyond the rim.

jobs.title: Класс: танк
jobs.subject: The Tank class: a heavy heater shield — a flat top and a pointed bottom — of dark oak and blackened iron, battered by countless blows, with a thick riveted rim and an old-gold boss; faint turquoise runes glow in the cracks of the iron, as if the shield itself refuses to break.

jobs.title: Редкость: эпическая (4 из 7)
jobs.source: GDD §3.1 — семь редкостей; цвет — токен --r4 интерфейса
jobs.subject: Epic rarity, the fourth of seven: a clean faceted violet crystal (#A986EE) with a strong violet light inside, bright inner facets, a soft violet aura around it and a few small violet shards floating nearby.
